title: serapias alba
intro: Serapias alba, commonly known as the white bee orchid, is a species of orchid native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support respiratory health and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Serapias alba are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of Serapias alba include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
